findings.title: cache NUMA capacity proxy may choose Store-pool node
findings.evidence: choose_node uses MemFree+FilePages; Store 716GiB pinned on node0; cache about 704GiB plus 64GiB margin; accept does not compare cache hot_placement.node with store-numa node
findings.impact: cache may be placed on node0 with the 716GiB Store, risking incomplete mincore/OOM; fail-closed but preventable
findings.verification: inspect hot-placement.node vs store-numa-launch.node; require different or use MemAvailable/exclude Store node

findings.title: cache accept does not verify initial-scan/repair/read-idle
findings.evidence: validate_cache checks final summary files and eviction only; repair_history, initial-scan, preparation.jsonl bytes_read and read_idle_receipt are written but not accepted
findings.impact: repair correctness and initial/read-idle proof are not independently verified
findings.verification: accept each repair selection/reads/summary and initial-scan; verify bytes_read and read-idle

findings.title: monitor gap uses monotonic_ns, not begin/end
findings.evidence: rows carry sample_begin_ns/monotonic_ns/sample_end_ns; accept computes max gap only from monotonic_ns and does not check sample duration or begin-to-begin
findings.impact: a slow sample's own duration may not be bounded; historical 33.8s gap motivation is not fully closed by the metric
findings.verification: accept sample_end-sample_begin and begin-to-begin; negative slow-sample test

findings.title: ancestor cgroup check excludes root and ignores memory.high
findings.evidence: loop stops before /sys/fs/cgroup; memory.high and memory.events read but only memory.max asserted
findings.impact: outer root/high limit could constrain the 1700G budget without preflight failure
findings.verification: include root, assert memory.max and numeric memory.high; record swap.max

findings.title: seal rewrites window but leaves overlay_created_utc stale
findings.evidence: seal updates run-manifest status and window original hash to 15a0e5... at 17:23 but overlay_created_utc remains 15:48:45Z
findings.impact: overlay claims a creation time before the manifest bytes it binds; F14 re-opened
findings.verification: set overlay_created_utc at window write; or freeze manifest before window

findings.title: cache initial read bytes and hot-placement final field not asserted
findings.evidence: repair asserts bytes_read==size but initial read_hot does not; hot-placement.json written before eviction_resident_pages is set
findings.impact: initial read completeness relies only on later mincore; hot-placement file lacks final eviction field
findings.verification: assert initial bytes_read==size; write hot-placement after eviction or rely only on summary

findings.title: cache LFS expected_sha256 not cross-checked
